item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The winter monsoon will continue to bring cold weather to southern China today. The weather will be fine and dry over the region. With the monsoon being replaced by an easterly airstream gradually today and tomorrow, it will be windy and become cloudier gradually over the coast of Guangdong. However, it will remain cool in the morning and at night. The easterly airstream will moderate over the weekend. It will be mild during the day and relatively humid over the coastal areas. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will become cold again over Guangdong early next week. There will be one or two rain patches over the region.

Weather: Mainly fine and dry.
Temp range: 13 - 19 C
R.H. range: 40 - 65 per Cent
